interactables.name: Doorway Placard
interactables.text: 'That was a DOORWAY. Chevrons mark them - stand inside and press Enter.|New room, new board: each room keeps its own clues and its own SOLVE. Finished rooms turn the button green. The counter in the corner tells you what is left.'

interactables.name: Open Window
interactables.text: An [open window] in a room with no weather. The curtain performs its impression of a ghost. [The wind] has been through here, and recently.|On the sill, someone has pinned a note: 'the wind did it, probably.' [Blaming the wind] is an old trick. The oldest.

interactables.name: Loose Latch
interactables.text: The [latch] hangs by one screw. It would not stop a determined moth. It did not stop whatever came through.

interactables.name: The Mailman (Cardboard)
interactables.text: A cardboard cutout of [the mailman], propped against nothing. Someone has drawn a suspicious mustache on him.|His placard: 'A red herring. Every case has one. Some have five.'

interactables.name: Graduation Scroll
interactables.text: A rolled scroll under glass: 'FINAL EXAM. Solve every room. Hear every confession. Then press FINAL SOLVE - the second button in the corner.|The final board only takes the big clues, the ones a room solve confirms. Pin down who, what, and why, and you graduate.'|Smaller, at the bottom: 'Then wake up, Dikkie. There is real work to do.'
